jtbd.jtbd_desc: Translate lived moments (voice chat, bias, belonging) into a scene-driven arc that lands on agency and pride.

source.title: Common App Essay—From Gaming Guilt to Pride

interactions.user_ask: How do I convey the final takeaway better?
interactions.jenny_reply: Name the trait you’re proving (resilience/leadership). End on a concrete re-entry action in games or community.
Use whatever keeps you writing; export to Docs for feedback cycles and versioning.
Two beats: masking in voice chat → reclaiming voice with a small proof. Bridge with one hinge sentence.

outcomes.name: essay_revision_plan_w059
outcomes.details: Add 2 scene cards; tighten last line to agency/pride; keep to 650 cap.
